question: What is the standard monthly Medicare Part B premium for 2026?
answer: The standard monthly Medicare Part B premium for 2026 is $202.90, up $17.90 from $185.00 in 2025 [4]. CMS released this figure on November 14, 2025 [4], and a separate summary of the 2026 rates gives the same amount [6]. The annual Part B deductible for 2026 is $283 [4]. Higher-income beneficiaries pay more through income-related adjustments [4].

keyPoints.text: The standard monthly Medicare Part B premium for 2026 is $202.90, up $17.90 from $185.00 in 2025.
CMS released the 2026 Part A and Part B premiums and deductibles on November 14, 2025.
The 2026 Part B annual deductible is $283, up from $257 in 2025.
Beneficiaries with high income pay income-related monthly adjustment amounts on top of the standard premium, so their total premium is higher.
